_about: English activities. Each topic has key words (with home-language translations), phrases for each English level, and one game with a tweak per level. TRANSLATIONS NEED A CHECK BY NATIVE SPEAKERS before campers see them.

topics.name: Ordering food

middle: Can I have the chicken and rice?
Can I get the bill, please?
confident: Does this have nuts in it?

game.name: Restaurant Role-Play
steps: Set up two or three 'tables' with a menu on each.
One student is the waiter. Everyone else at the table is a customer.
Customers order out loud. The waiter repeats the order back.
Swap waiters every round so everyone gets both roles.
Teams earn a point for every full order said out loud.

tweaks.beginner: Use picture menus. Customers point, then say the word plus 'please'.
tweaks.middle: Customers order in full sentences and ask how much it costs.
tweaks.confident: The waiter gets 'problem cards' (no more chicken, wrong order) and customers must sort it out politely.

topics.wrapup: What is one thing you can order in English now?

topics.name: Riding the bus

confident: Can you tell me when we get to ___?
Which bus should I take to get downtown?
I think I missed my stop. What should I do?

game.name: Bus Route Race
steps: Line up chairs like a bus. Tape a map with stops to the wall.
One student is the driver. Riders get a card with where they need to go.
Riders must ask the driver out loud before they board.
The driver answers and calls out each stop.
Teams race to get every rider to the right stop. Points for each correct question.

tweaks.beginner: Riders point at the map and use 'left', 'right' and 'stop'.
tweaks.middle: Riders ask a full question before boarding and when to get off.
tweaks.confident: Add 'detour cards': the route changes and riders must ask for a new way.

topics.wrapup: Where would you take the bus this week?

topics.name: Starting at a new school

middle: What class do we have next?
I don't understand. Can you say it again?
confident: Do you want to eat lunch together?
I'm new here. What clubs are there?

game.name: New Kid Scavenger Hunt
steps: Turn the room into a school with labeled stations.
Each student gets a schedule card with places to visit.
To get to each place, they must ask someone for directions out loud.
At each station, they collect a sticker.
First team to fill every schedule card wins.

tweaks.beginner: Picture schedule cards. Ask 'Where is ___?' and point.
tweaks.middle: Ask full questions and give directions back to others.
tweaks.confident: Add social challenges: invite someone to lunch, ask about clubs.

topics.wrapup: What is one question you could ask on your first day?

topics.name: Going to the doctor

middle: I have had a headache for two days.
How often do I take this medicine?
confident: The pain gets worse when I ___.
Can I get a note for school or work?

game.name: Doctor's Office Charades
steps: A patient picks a symptom card and acts it out.
The patient then says the symptom out loud in English.
The doctor guesses and asks one follow-up question.
The doctor writes a pretend 'prescription' and explains it.
Teams score a point for every full sentence.

tweaks.beginner: Patients point to the body part and say 'My ___ hurts.'
tweaks.middle: Patients say how long it has hurt. Doctors ask 'How often?'
tweaks.confident: Doctors ask three questions and explain the medicine and side effects.

topics.wrapup: If you felt sick tomorrow, what would you say?

topics.name: Job interviews

middle: I am a hard worker and I like teamwork.
confident: Let me tell you about myself.
One of my strengths is ___ because ___.
What does a normal day look like in this job?

game.name: Hot Seat Interview
steps: Three students sit as the 'managers' with question cards.
A candidate picks a job ad card and takes the hot seat.
Managers ask questions. The candidate answers out loud.
Managers give points for eye contact, full sentences and one real example.
Rotate until everyone has been in the hot seat.

tweaks.beginner: Two questions only, with sentence starters on the card.
tweaks.middle: Four questions. The candidate asks one question back.
tweaks.confident: A surprise question at the end. The candidate gives a 30-second pitch.

topics.wrapup: What job would you like, and what would you say about yourself?

topics.name: Opening a bank account

beginner: I want to open an account.
middle: What do I need to open an account?
How do I get a debit card?
confident: What is the difference between checking and savings?
Can I set up direct deposit?
What happens if I lose my card?

game.name: Bank Teller Challenge
steps: Set up a 'teller desk' with forms and play money.
Customers draw a task card: open an account, deposit money, report a lost card.
The teller must ask for ID and address before helping.
Customers fill in the form and say each answer out loud.
Teams earn points for each task finished in English.

tweaks.beginner: Only the 'open an account' task. Point to the form and say the word.
tweaks.middle: All three tasks. Customers ask about fees.
tweaks.confident: The teller explains checking vs savings and the customer chooses.

topics.wrapup: What is one thing you would ask at a bank?
